note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3 and the Section 3.6 Disconnect table at HEAD (coa.go unsupportedAttr, disconnectSupportedAttrs). TestRFC5176DisconnectWithANonIdentificationAttributeIsNAKed sends Filter-Id, Framed-MTU, Session-Timeout, Idle-Timeout, Service-Type and State beside valid session identification and asserts Disconnect-NAK, Error-Cause [401] and zero teardowns. TestRFC5176DisconnectCarryingOnlyIdentificationIsACKed confirms ACK and one teardown with implemented identification selectors alone, and TestRFC5176DisconnectAdmitsTheSection36TableAttributes confirms ACK, no Error-Cause and one teardown each for Reply-Message, Class and Acct-Terminate-Cause individually and together.
